native_test_entries: test1: {'state': {'sevseg1': '0', 'sevseg2': '0'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After power-on or reset, both 7-segment displays show 0, forming the number 00.'}

test2: {'state': {'sevseg1': '3', 'sevseg2': '7'}, 'description': 'First button press. After pressing the button once, the number increments by 37, so the displays show 37 (tens digit 3, units digit 7).'}

test3: {'state': {'sevseg1': '7', 'sevseg2': '4'}, 'description': 'Second button press. After pressing the button twice, the number increments by another 37 (total 74), so the displays show 74 (tens digit 7, units digit 4).'}

test4: {'state': {'sevseg1': '0', 'sevseg2': '0'}, 'description': 'Third button press. After pressing the button three times, the number increments by another 37 (total 111), which exceeds 99, so the displays reset to 00 (tens digit 0, units digit 0).'}
